## Pick a real model when you launch a coding CLI

`chatoss launch opencode|claude-code|codex` now opens a **model picker** on your
own ChatOSS models — most recently used first, with the model you're currently
using on top. Type to filter, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to select, Esc to cancel.

```bash
chatoss launch opencode                       # pick a model at launch
chatoss launch opencode --model glm-5.3:cloud  # or pin one and skip the picker
```

The picker lists everything your ChatOSS model selector shows: local Ollama
models, Ollama `:cloud` tags, your saved ChatOSS cloud models, and models from
your own providers under Settings → API keys.

### The CLI now shows the real model name

Previously every launch handed the CLI one opaque handle, so OpenCode's status
line read **"ChatOSS model ChatOSS"** and its `/models` list had a single
meaningless row. Now the CLI is told the model you picked, and *all* your
ChatOSS models are registered with their real names — so the status line shows
the actual model, and `/models` (or codex's `/model`) lists your models and
**switching there actually switches the backing model**, no relaunch needed.

Your API keys still never leave ChatOSS: the CLI talks to the local server on
127.0.0.1, and the server attaches credentials on the way out.

### Also in this release

- Settings → Launch drops the long explainer for a single line about `--model`
  being optional.
- **Build fix:** the universal macOS build was bundling a *stale* `chatoss` CLI
  binary — the lipo/sign step that produces it was a manual script nothing
  invoked, so the bundler copied whatever was left from an earlier build.
  v1.14.2 shipped a stale CLI this way (harmless there, since the CLI hadn't
  changed). It is now part of every build via `beforeBundleCommand`, and the
  release check proves the bundled binary is the one just built.

### Upgrading

The in-app **Update** button works normally from v1.14.2. If you are still on
v1.13.0, v1.14.0, or v1.14.1 — the versions that crashed on launch — the app
aborts before you can click Update, so reinstall instead:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://chatoss.ai/install.sh | sh
```

### Platforms

macOS universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), Windows x64, Linux x86_64.
